question: If S-104's next RM-221 shipment ships two weeks late, when will DC-EAST run out of Lacrivia, when will supply recover there, and which customers get supply first under our allocation rules?
answer:
I can give you the stockout date, but not a firm recovery date or a customer priority order. The data has no lead times and no allocation rules.

**When DC-EAST runs out of Lacrivia:** it's already out, or will be within days, regardless of the delay. The stockout comes before the PO's original ship date, so the two-week slip doesn't move it.

| SKU | On hand (2026-09-25) | Safety stock | Avg weekly demand (last 13 wks) | Weekly inbound since mid-Aug | Estimated stockout |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FG-1001 Lacrivia 5 mL | 46 | 471 | 244 | ~106–141 | ~Sep 26–27 |
| FG-1002 Lacrivia 10 mL | 34 | 233 | 116 | ~56–68 | ~Sep 27–29 |

- Inbound to DC-EAST has run at roughly half of demand since the week of Aug 21.
- In the week to Sep 11, about 259 + 123 more units left DC-EAST stock than shipped to customers. It looks like a write-off or quality hold; it's worth confirming.

**When supply recovers:**
- **The delayed shipment:** the next RM-221 shipment from S-104 (Delmar Specialty Chemicals, India) is PO005791, 4,200 units. It was due to ship Oct 7; two weeks late means **Oct 21**.
- **Why it matters:** S-104 is the only qualified supplier of RM-221. The other supplier on file, S-131, isn't qualified, so there's no backup. The current BOM (bill of materials) makes RM-221 a direct input to every Lacrivia unit: RM-221 → emulsifier premix CMP-310 → bulk SEMI-031 → bulk SEMI-044 → filled bottles → FG-1001/FG-1002, all made at plant PL-01. RM-221 was also in CMP-320, but that link ended 2025-06-30, so I left it out.
- **Recovery date:** Oct 21 plus the time for shipping from India, manufacturing at PL-01, quality release and delivery to DC-EAST. None of these lead times are in the data. Recovery is therefore at least two weeks later than the no-delay plan, and DC-EAST stays out of stock until then. Give me the lead time and I can turn this into a date.
- **Stopgap:** DC-CENTRAL and DC-WEST hold about 695 units of FG-1001 and 391 of FG-1002 above their safety stock. That's roughly 3 weeks of DC-EAST demand if transferred.

**Which customers get supply first:** I can't say. I found no allocation rules anywhere in the supply or commercial data, and I didn't make up a ranking. DC-EAST serves two wholesalers:
- W-01 Keystone Drug Distributors: 52% of DC-EAST Lacrivia volume over the last 12 months.
- W-02 Atlas Pharma Supply: 48%.

If the allocation policy lives in a separate document or system, send it and I'll apply it. A pro-rata split on these historical shares is a neutral default, but it would need approval as policy.

**Sources and definitions:**
- **Supply data (Fabric):**
  - PURCH_ORD: next open RM-221 order = earliest open PO.
  - SUPPLIER_MATERIAL: qualified sources.
  - BOM: current links only.
  - PLANT_MATERIAL: where Lacrivia is made.
  - DC_INV: latest snapshot 2026-09-25.
  - WHSLR_SHIP and WHSLR: DC-EAST shipments to wholesalers.
  - MATERIAL: Lacrivia = FG-1001/FG-1002.
- **Commercial data (Snowflake):** checked for allocation rules; none found.
- **Definitions:**
  - Demand = DC-EAST shipments to wholesalers, weeks of Jun 29 – Sep 21.
  - Weekly inbound = change in on-hand + shipments out.
- **Assumptions:**
  - Stockout dates assume current demand and the recent inbound rate. With no inbound at all, both SKUs run out a day or two sooner.
  - "Late" applies to the ship date only.

sql.sql: SELECT m.MATERIAL_ID, m.MATERIAL_DESC, m.MATERIAL_TYP, m.PACK_SZ FROM dbo.MATERIAL m WHERE m.MATERIAL_DESC LIKE '%Lacrivia%' OR m.MATERIAL_ID IN ('RM-221') OR m.MATERIAL_ID IN (SELECT PARENT_MATERIAL_ID FROM dbo.BOM WHERE CHILD_MATERIAL_ID='RM-221') OR m.MATERIAL_ID IN (SELECT CHILD_MATERIAL_ID FROM dbo.BOM WHERE PARENT_MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002'))
SELECT * FROM dbo.SUPPLIER_MATERIAL WHERE MATERIAL_ID='RM-221' OR SUPPLIER_ID='S-104'

WITH x AS (
 SELECT PARENT_MATERIAL_ID, CHILD_MATERIAL_ID, QTY_PER, EFF_FROM, EFF_TO, 1 AS lvl FROM dbo.BOM WHERE CHILD_MATERIAL_ID='RM-221'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID, b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID, b.QTY_PER, b.EFF_FROM, b.EFF_TO, x.lvl+1 FROM dbo.BOM b JOIN x ON b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID = x.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID WHERE x.lvl<6
) SELECT * FROM x

sql.sql: SELECT * FROM dbo.BOM WHERE PARENT_MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FILL-1001','FILL-1002','CMP-310','CMP-320') ORDER BY PARENT_MATERIAL_ID

SELECT b.*, m.MATERIAL_DESC FROM dbo.BOM b LEFT JOIN dbo.MATERIAL m ON m.MATERIAL_ID=b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID WHERE b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID IN ('RM-221','CMP-310','CMP-320','SEMI-044') OR b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID='SEMI-044' ORDER BY b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID
SELECT * FROM dbo.PURCH_ORD WHERE MATERIAL_ID='RM-221' ORDER BY PROMISED_SHIP_DT
SELECT TOP 20 * FROM dbo.PURCH_ORD_ARCHIVE WHERE MATERIAL_ID='RM-221' ORDER BY PROMISED_SHIP_DT DESC

SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, SNAPSHOT_DT, ON_HAND_UNITS, SAFETY_STOCK_UNITS FROM dbo.DC_INV WHERE DC_ID='DC-EAST' AND MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SNAPSHOT_DT >= '2026-06-01' ORDER BY MATERIAL_ID, SNAPSHOT_DT

SELECT s.MATERIAL_ID, s.WHSLR_ID, w.WHSLR_NM, w.REGION, COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.UNITS) units, MIN(s.SHIP_DT) mn, MAX(s.SHIP_DT) mx FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP s LEFT JOIN dbo.WHSLR w ON w.WHSLR_ID=s.WHSLR_ID WHERE s.DC_ID='DC-EAST' AND s.MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') GROUP BY s.MATERIAL_ID, s.WHSLR_ID, w.WHSLR_NM, w.REGION ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT s.MATERIAL_ID, DATEADD(day, -((DATEPART(weekday, s.SHIP_DT)+5)%7), s.SHIP_DT) wk_mon, SUM(CASE WHEN WHSLR_ID='W-01' THEN UNITS ELSE 0 END) w01, SUM(CASE WHEN WHSLR_ID='W-02' THEN UNITS ELSE 0 END) w02, SUM(UNITS) tot FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP s WHERE s.DC_ID='DC-EAST' AND s.MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND s.SHIP_DT>='2026-06-01' GROUP BY s.MATERIAL_ID, DATEADD(day, -((DATEPART(weekday, s.SHIP_DT)+5)%7), s.SHIP_DT) ORDER BY 1,2

WITH inv AS (
 SELECT MATERIAL_ID, SNAPSHOT_DT, ON_HAND_UNITS, LAG(SNAPSHOT_DT) OVER (PARTITION BY MATERIAL_ID ORDER BY SNAPSHOT_DT) prev_dt, LAG(ON_HAND_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY MATERIAL_ID ORDER BY SNAPSHOT_DT) prev_oh
 FROM dbo.DC_INV WHERE DC_ID='DC-EAST' AND MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SNAPSHOT_DT>='2026-05-01')
SELECT i.MATERIAL_ID, i.SNAPSHOT_DT, i.ON_HAND_UNITS, (SELECT SUM(UNITS) FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP s WHERE s.DC_ID='DC-EAST' AND s.MATERIAL_ID=i.MATERIAL_ID AND s.SHIP_DT>i.prev_dt AND s.SHIP_DT<=i.SNAPSHOT_DT) shipped,
 i.ON_HAND_UNITS - i.prev_oh + (SELECT SUM(UNITS) FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP s WHERE s.DC_ID='DC-EAST' AND s.MATERIAL_ID=i.MATERIAL_ID AND s.SHIP_DT>i.prev_dt AND s.SHIP_DT<=i.SNAPSHOT_DT) implied_receipts
FROM inv i WHERE prev_dt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, MAX(SNAPSHOT_DT) last_dt, COUNT(*) n FROM dbo.DC_INV GROUP BY DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT * FROM dbo.PLANT_MATERIAL WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FILL-1001','FILL-1002','SEMI-044','SEMI-031','CMP-310','RM-221')

SELECT i.DC_ID, i.MATERIAL_ID, i.ON_HAND_UNITS, i.SAFETY_STOCK_UNITS, (SELECT SUM(UNITS)/13.0 FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP s WHERE s.DC_ID=i.DC_ID AND s.MATERIAL_ID=i.MATERIAL_ID AND s.SHIP_DT>'2026-06-26' AND s.SHIP_DT<='2026-09-25') avg_wk_ship FROM dbo.DC_INV i WHERE i.SNAPSHOT_DT='2026-09-25' AND i.MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') ORDER BY 2,1
